hud: versus results (n-player arc PR 4 -- FFA + teams, .hud-coop-kills precedent) win panel carries the teams results line as PER-TEAM sums, not per-slot
why: Puts the per-competitor figures back on one run-on line, which is what the owner's ruling replaced: at four players `P1: 6/2 \u00b7 P2: 2/6 \u00b7 P3: 1/5 \u00b7 P4: 0/6` is a row of numbers a reader has to parse before they can compare anyone to anyone. The killers read ROWS OF CELLS rather than `textContent` for exactly this reason -- a string comparison cannot tell a table from the same digits run together, so a test written that way would have passed this mutation. Re-anchored when the accuracy column landed: the collapsed line now carries three figures per competitor, which is worse still on one line -- `Player 1: 6/2 36% · Player 2: 2/6 11% · ...`. RE-ANCHORED for issue #629: the assignment grew a caption and a <thead>, so the find string is the whole five-line assignment now. Widened rather than trimmed to the first line on purpose -- a one-line anchor here would leave the remaining four lines dangling after the mutation and fail to compile, which reports as a kill for the wrong reason.
